scope: Actual CPU Cycles source renders under identical temporary neutral studio setup. No game lighting, native or library-publication claim.
reuse_layout: left OakLonggrain, middle OakEndgrain, right LimePlaster. Top row2x2m, lower row4x2m; six independent meshes, three shared material datablocks.

observations.wide: Warm oak framing and sloped board underside remain coherent; grain follows members. Material consolidation keeps original construction/palette recognizable. Existing fireplace is protected context.
observations.joinery: New relief is quieter/finer than previous coarse wood normal. Peg placement and visible silhouette are unchanged. V2 endgrain softens regular bands and adds multiscale periodic warp; tiny peg caps still show only segments, not a measured growth-ring scan.
observations.gable: Plaster is a quiet cream finish with restrained mottling. Dark junction slivers already visible in baseline remain; no geometry/opening edits were authorized.
observations.reuse: Six unrelated surfaces use exact same three role materials. V2 endgrain is less regular/high contrast than V1; source remains an authored procedural approximation, not a measured scan. Repeated tiling visible at2/4m is expected.
observations.limitations: Material-only derivative, not a comprehensive photoreal ceiling rebuild. Original bevel UV compression and duplicate-face importer behavior remain explicit. Root visual approval and all native optical/collision/gameplay validation remain pending.
